meta.title: AI20K Cohort V (Cohort 5) - Phase 1 timetable
notes: Room codes are abbreviated: H209 = room H2-209 (building H2). Letter = building, digits = floor+room.
A room code with backup:true is a standby room, not the primary assignment.
Session rooms[] on a group session = all rooms used by that group that session (students split across rooms). Per-student room is in students[].rooms[session_id].
room "?" = pending, organizers have not assigned a room yet. null = no physical room (online or opening ceremony).
student short_name is abbreviated (initials + given name) in source; full names are only stored as hashes in source so cannot be recovered.
Organizers will announce changes via email or Discord.
